verdict.rationale:
Hatchet explicitly documents Cron Runs and Scheduled Runs as first-class workflow trigger types, alongside concurrency/rate-limit controls, giving clear support for scheduling recurring jobs/workflows (hatchet-docs-16, hatchet-docs-26, hatchet-docs-27). This is corroborated by the general orchestration platform framing in GitHub docs and self-hosting control plane description.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of cron/scheduled run reliability at scale, and more detail on failure/edge-case handling for recurring jobs.
